The PR adds logic to capitalize small words after colons (e.g., "field: a" → "Field: A"), but this behavior is not documented in the docstring specification, which is the stated "source of truth." 

The docstring's Rule 2 only specifies that small words should be capitalized if they are the first or last word of the text. The word "a" in test_subtitle_after_colon (index 4 of 9) is neither first nor last, so according to the docstring it should be lowercase, yet the test expects uppercase.

The after_colon logic appears to be test-specific behavior added solely to make that test pass. To fix this:
- Either update the docstring to document this after_colon capitalization rule as part of the specification, or
- Remove the after_colon logic to align with the documented behavior

The code should match its documentation.
